Additions__c:
A new 'Only me' dashboard, to our Coaches workbench where coaches are able to view their own work without having to scroll through the large list of cases.
Coaches can now create a Bug Enquiry case. 
Coaches now have access to edit a Bug Enquiry case, remove related bugs in General Enquiry page layout and link multiple bug enquiry cases to one master bug record.
We have allowed coaches to view customers transaction history on their Everyday and Goals account 
We applied shield platform encryption to all fields, by clicking Sync on the encryption statistics setup page.
Name: Alpha 5 Release 1 - Accounts and Goals and Transactions

Additions__c:
Create permissions and entitlements for the various Salesforce roles that are intended to be used in the future Beta release (such as QA, support coach, etc.)
Add dispute functionality, such as ability for a coach to raise a dispute case using existing case management process, view the dispute case created, edit dispute case when required to facilitate the assistance of customers who would like to raise a dispute for an ANZx transaction
Add a UI integration to Twilio to allow a coach to receive inbound voice calls from ANZx customers
Add basic complaints case functionality, such as ability for a coach to create and view an ANZx customer complaint
Add some additional granularity on user interface controls on customer Accounts and Goals
General technical debt items
Fixes__c: Bug fixes within Dispute Management, Fraud Management, Complaints Management, Voice Calling and Transaction History.
Name: Alpha 5 Release 3 - Disputes , UAM, Tech Debt

Additions__c:
We expanded upon our existing case duration lightning web component build.
FraudX users can now log notes related to a fraud case.
Added new record types so that FraudX staff are now presented with only the relevant fields for the selected case type.
We have applied shield platform encryption to all fields by enabling sync on the encryption statistics setup page.
Fixes__c:
Within this release, we seperated business hours for ANZx cases. There was an issue where business hours had been updated for all cases including CMOS.
issue during BVT where the transaction page was throwing an error due to a JSON parsing issue. This was fixed by adding null checks to all elements we were trying to read and display if it had value.
Name: Alpha 5 Release 2 - OCV integration and Fraud
